info.name: AISafe - Global System
info.description:
Integration tests for the AISafe platform, through the API Gateway.

**Before running**
1. Start the system (`docker compose up`) and wait for the services to register in Eureka.
2. Import the `AISafe - Local` environment and select it.
3. In the Postman app, turn off *Settings > General > SSL certificate verification*: the gateway uses a self-signed certificate.

**Organisation**
One folder per microservice, split by resource or capability, plus cross-cutting folders for Gateway/Discovery, end-to-end journeys and known issues.
Request names follow `Action - expected status [user story]`.

**Authentication and data**
Requests inherit `Bearer {{token}}` from the collection. The collection-level script logs in automatically and generates unique names per run. See `00 - Setup` to repeat a run.

Full details in `docs/postman/README.md`.

item.name: 00 - Setup
item.description:
Run this first when you repeat the collection in the Postman app: it logs in and discards the generated names, so the next request creates a fresh set (`runId`, `modelName`, `airportIata`, ...).

Not mandatory for a first run: the collection-level pre-request script generates the data and logs in automatically when they are missing.

item.name: 01 - Auth Service
item.description: `/api/auth/**` is the only route without the gateway JWT filter. Users are created by the auth-service Bootstrap. Each login stores a role token (`adminToken`, `backofficeToken`, ...): the requests in this collection use `{{token}}`, and role tokens exist to try a call as another user.

item.name: 09 - Known Issues
item.description:
Bugs found while building this collection. Each test pins the **current, incorrect** behaviour, so a run stays green and the bugs stay visible.

When one of these requests starts failing, the bug was probably fixed: update the expectation and move the request to its service folder.

item.name: Duplicate model overwrites the existing one
item.description:
**Current:** A second POST with the same `modelName` answers 201 and replaces the model.

**Should be:** 409 Conflict. The `AddModelUseCase` Javadoc says the duplicate is rejected.

**Where:** `aircraft-service: AddModelUseCase.execute uses save() on the @Id`

item.name: Create same model with another manufacturer - 201 [US101]
Fuel efficiency summary fails when flights exist
item.description:
**Current:** 500, NullPointerException.

**Should be:** 200 with the efficiency per aircraft and per flight.

**Where:** `aircraft-service: HangarController.getFuelEfficiency reads flight.range(), which flight-service never sends`

item.name: Compatible routes are always empty
item.description:
**Current:** [] for every aircraft whose meanRange is 0, which is the value of all aircraft on creation.

**Should be:** The routes the aircraft can fly. D-ABXA (5436 km, 189 seats) fits seeded route 1.

**Where:** `aircraft-service: RouteSearchService.findCompatibleRoutes overwrites the model range with meanRange`

exec: pm.test("Response is an empty array", function () {

item.name: Suspended routes cannot be reactivated
item.description:
**Current:** 409 'Retired routes cannot be activated' for an INACTIVE route.

**Should be:** 200. The check should refuse ARCHIVED, the state used for retired routes.

**Where:** `route-service: Route.activateRoute compares against RouteStatus.INACTIVE`

exec: pm.test("Error message mentions the cause", function () {

item.name: Filtering records without an aircraft fails
item.description:
**Current:** 500, NullPointerException, although `aircraft` is optional.

**Should be:** 200 with the records matching the other filters.

**Where:** `maintenance-service: MaintenanceRecordSearchService calls aircraftRegistration.isEmpty() without a null check`

item.name: Missing required query parameter answers 500
item.description:
**Current:** 500 from the generic exception handler.

**Should be:** 400 Bad Request.

**Where:** `route-service: GlobalExceptionHandler has no handler for MissingServletRequestParameterException`
